test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Your success were short-lived and had disastrous outcomes.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Your success were."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to subject-verb agreement, a singular subject takes a singular verb and a plural verb takes a plural verb.
 
• The subject **'success'** is singular, so the verb should be **'was'** instead of **'were'.**
 
• So, the correct answer is** option 4.**

 

**Correct sentence:*** **Your success was**__ short-lived and had disastrous outcomes.*
